title: OSRS: a beginner's guide and RuneLite plugins
description: The full path through Old School RuneScape for the free version: from the first step after Tutorial Island to rune armour after Dragon Slayer I. Follow the "Step-by-step plan", and open the skill sections when a step sends you there for details.

blocks.text: You sign in to the game with a Jagex account only through the Jagex Launcher: a login and password typed straight into the client window do not work.

items.text: Download the Jagex Launcher from jagex.com and sign in with your Jagex account's email and password.
Choose Old School RuneScape and create a character if needed.
In the list of clients choose RuneLite and press Play. After that the launcher remembers your sign-in.

blocks.text: Graphics on a Dell Latitude 5420 (Intel Iris Xe):

items.text: **GPU**: a stable 60+ fps and the original picture. You can raise the draw distance and turn on anti-aliasing.
**117 HD**: nice lighting, shadows and water. On medium settings roughly 40-60 fps; for a stable 60 cut the draw distance (30-40 tiles), shadows and anti-aliasing.
**GPU and 117 HD cannot be on at the same time**: 117 HD replaces GPU. Only one of them should be enabled.
To play in the background set a limit of 10-20 frames for the inactive window in **FPS Control**.
Check that the laptop has two memory sticks (dual-channel mode) and play on mains power in the maximum performance mode.
The AFK logout timer in the client settings can be raised to 30 minutes.

blocks.text: You do not need to buy membership right away: the free version is enough for dozens of hours, and the whole guide above is played for free.

Plus Agility, Thieving, Herblore, Farming, Slayer, Construction and others

items.text: When membership ends your progress is kept; only the members skills and areas are closed.
You can buy membership with in-game gold through an **Old School Bond** on the Grand Exchange.
Check Jagex's website for the current price.

sections.title: If you do not know what to do

items.text: **Is there a quest in the current stage?** Do it: quests give XP, money and Quest Points, without which Dragon Slayer I will not open.
**Fewer than 20 pieces of food in the bank?** Go fishing and cook.
**Can you wear better metal?** Smith or buy it.
**Is combat behind the peaceful skills?** Go and fight.
**Otherwise**: any peaceful skill you feel like right now.

blocks.text: A good rhythm: 30-40 minutes of combat, then 30-40 minutes of a peaceful skill. It does not get boring, and the resources pile up on their own.
Before you start enable the **Quest Helper** plugin (see "RuneLite plugins"): it will walk you through every quest in the plan.

Walking the map takes long. In the free version the way is shortened by teleports, canoes on the River Lum and the boat to Karamja. Where that pays, the step has a **⚡ Fast option**: the app checks your level and items itself, and the "Guide me this way in game" button points the in-game arrow along it.

head: Where you need to go
By what
Cost
rows: To Lumbridge: the castle bank, the range, the swamp
The first time to the Stronghold of Security
To Varrock and the Grand Exchange
Up to Magic 25 the Chronicle book, from 25 Varrock Teleport
A book charge is a card from 150 gp; the runes for a teleport are about 130 gp
Along the River Lum: Lumbridge, Champions' Guild, Barbarian Village, Edgeville
Free, you need an axe and Woodcutting from 12

blocks.text: **Home Teleport: free, home to Lumbridge**

This is the **Lumbridge Home Teleport** spell. Every character has it from day one: it is in the ordinary spellbook (Standard spellbook), and needs no runes or Magic level. Another spellbook can be taken only with membership, and it has its own home teleport, not to Lumbridge.

items.text: Open the Magic tab on the side panel. Lumbridge Home Teleport is the first icon, in the top-left corner.
Click it and do nothing for about 14 seconds while the animation plays: a click on the ground, another action or a monster's hit will interrupt it.
You appear in front of Lumbridge Castle.
It needs no runes or Magic level and gives no XP.
It works once every 30 minutes. While it recharges the icon is grey, and if you press it the chat tells you how many minutes are left.
It does not work in combat: step away from the monster and wait 10 seconds.
It does not work deeper than Wilderness level 20.
**When:** you have finished business far from Lumbridge: return by teleport rather than on foot. It recharges by itself, so spend it every time you need to be in Lumbridge.

**If the icon is grey** (the teleport is recharging): walk, take a canoe along the River Lum, or from Magic 31 use Lumbridge Teleport for runes. A Shortest Path route that starts with "Lumbridge Home Teleport" is no good at that moment: walk, or turn off "Use Home Teleport spells" in its settings.

blocks.text: **Count Check: one free teleport to the Stronghold of Security**

He stands in the Lumbridge graveyard, south of the church. Talk-to, "Where can I learn more about security?", "Yes". It works once and only if you have never been to the Stronghold of Security. Save it for step S1-09.
**The Chronicle book: to Champions' Guild by Varrock**

items.text: Buy it from Diango in the Draynor Village market: right-click him, Trade. The book is 300 gp, a Teleport card is from 150 gp, and each next one is a little dearer.
Charge it: pick a card (Use) and click the book. One card is one charge, up to 1,000 in all. All the cards in your bag go at once, and noted cards do not charge the book.
To teleport, **right-click the book, Teleport**. A plain click wields it in the shield slot (Wield). A wielded book can also be used: right-click it in the equipment tab, Teleport.
You arrive at Champions' Guild south of Varrock. Next to it are a canoe station and the South-west Varrock mine; the Grand Exchange is north through the city.
The charges that are left: right-click, Check charges.
To the north-east of the arrival point is a stone circle with dark wizards (Dark wizard). They attack on their own and hit weak characters hard: do not go near the circle.
The book does not work in the Wilderness.
If you die and the book was not among the protected items, it is lost. Diango sells a new one, and the charges are kept.
**When:** you need Varrock or the exchange and do not have Magic 25 yet, or you have run out of runes for Varrock Teleport.

blocks.text: **Varrock Teleport: from Magic 25**

items.text: Every teleport needs runes: 1 Law rune, 3 Air rune and 1 Fire rune. A wielded Staff of air replaces the air runes, and a Staff of fire the fire runes.
Magic tab, Varrock Teleport. The icon glows when you have the level and runes; hover over it and the tooltip shows how many of which runes you need.
A couple of seconds later you are on the square by the fountain in the centre of Varrock, not far from the Varrock West bank.
Every teleport is 35 Magic XP, which is why Magic is trained with it up to level 31 (step S3-09).
At Magic 31 Lumbridge Teleport opens (3 Air, 1 Earth, 1 Law): to Lumbridge Castle without the long Home Teleport animation; at 37, Falador Teleport (3 Air, 1 Water, 1 Law): to the west Falador bank.
**When:** always, when you need Varrock or the exchange. It drops you closer to the bank and the exchange than the book does.

blocks.text: **Canoes on the River Lum**

The stations in order: Lumbridge (the master Barfy Bill, the east bank north of the bridge by the castle), Champions' Guild (Tarquin), Barbarian Village (Sigurd), Edgeville (Hari), Ferox Enclave (Marten, only on a Waka). The higher your Woodcutting, the farther a canoe goes in one trip:

head: Canoe
Woodcutting
XP
Stops
rows: Any station, including the one in the Wilderness

items.text: Take an axe you can chop with, in the bag or in your hands. You can hand the axe to the station master (right-click, Store-axe): it is stored for all the stations at once, and you do not need to carry it.
Click the station (Canoe Station), "Chop-down": the character fells a tree, sometimes in several attempts.
"Shape-Canoe", then in the window choose the canoe for your Woodcutting level.
"Float Log" (for the other canoes, "Float Canoe"): launch the canoe on the water.
"Paddle Log" ("Paddle Canoe"), then in the window choose the stop.
At the destination the canoe sinks. To go back you need a new canoe at that station.
If you made a canoe and did not sail, it waits at that station until you log out.

**Do not sail to the Wilderness Pond.** It is the deep Wilderness: there is no station there, you can only walk back, and teleports do not work. The game asks again, so answer "Eeep! The Wilderness... No thank you"

**When:** the target is near a station: the Stronghold of Security and fly fishing at Barbarian Village, Champions' Guild and the mine by Varrock, Edgeville. Especially when Home Teleport is recharging. With Woodcutting 42 you can paddle from Lumbridge to Edgeville in one trip: the Grand Exchange is next to it, and you do not need to spend on the book.

blocks.text: **The boat to Karamja**

items.text: Take at least 60 gp in your bag: 30 there and 30 back.

On the Port Sarim dock talk to any of the sailors: Captain Tobias, Seaman Lorris or Seaman Thresnor: Talk-to, "Yes please". If the right-click menu has a Travel or Musa Point option, he takes you at once.
You land at the Musa Point dock on Karamja.

To come back, the Customs officer on the same dock: Talk-to, "Can I journey on this ship?", "Search away, I have nothing to hide", "Ok". The Travel or Port Sarim option in the right-click menu, if there is one, is faster.
Customs takes away Karamjan rum: in Pirate's Treasure (step S2-09) it is smuggled in the crate with the bananas.
If you have no money left for the way back, talk to Luthas at the banana plantation and put 10 bananas in the crate: he pays 30 gp.
**When:** Pirate's Treasure, and lobsters and swordfish at Musa Point (steps S4-04 and S6-02).

blocks.text: **Shortest Path hints**

The plugin inserts teleports, canoes and ships into the route itself when they beat walking and you have everything needed. At the place where it is time to use one, it labels what to do: the teleport's name (for example "Lumbridge Home Teleport"), the canoe stop or the dialogue option. An unwanted method can be turned off in the plugin's settings, for example "Use Home Teleport spells" or "Use canoes".

items.text: **Home Teleport** in the Magic tab takes you home to Lumbridge for free, once every half hour. How to use it, and when the book, a canoe or a boat is better, is in the section [Teleports, canoes and boats](#/reference/transport).
**Running** drains energy fast: turn it on when it matters.
**The Wilderness** north of Edgeville is a zone where players can kill you and take your things. A beginner should not go there.
After you die your things lie in the grave for a while: get back for them in time.
"Double your money", "free items" and unfamiliar links are always a scam.
Jagex bans autoclickers, bots and mouse "jigglers".
On a phone it is convenient to train AFK, but quests and combat are better on a PC. The account is shared.
The game is in English only: Quest Helper and the wiki help with unfamiliar terms.

blocks.text: The sections below are a reference for the step-by-step plan. The free skills are written for the free version, and what opens only with membership is marked separately. The eight members skills are gathered at the end, in the "Members skills" section.

items.text: **Range codes.** Every row in the training tables has a code: `WC-2` is Woodcutting, the second level range. The tracker app can show the right row for you from your skill level.

**Tools.** Axes and pickaxes: bronze and iron from level 1, steel from 6, black from 11, mithril from 21, adamant from 31, rune from 41. The speed rises noticeably with every metal: buy the best available.
**Skill chains:** Woodcutting to Firemaking; Fishing to Cooking to food; Mining to Smithing to armour and weapons; combat to bones and hides to Prayer and Crafting.
**Banks:** Lumbridge (the top floor of the castle), Draynor, Varrock (two), Falador (two), Edgeville, Al Kharid.
**Drop or bank?** For fast XP drop what you gather (turn on "Shift click to drop" in the settings). For money and your own materials carry it to the bank.
